svg.title: Azure Red Team and Blue Team lab architecture
svg.desc: Private VNet-integrated Azure Container Instances lab with isolated attacker and victim subnets, telemetry into Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel, and a SOC workflow.
svg.text: Azure Red Team + Blue Team Lab — Option A (Private VNet-Integrated ACI)
Region: westus3 | Resource Group: rg-redblue-lab | No public ingress anywhere
Outbound egress (image pull / apt) via ACI managed egress. NO inbound from internet to any container.
SOC WORKFLOW: Detect → Triage → Investigate (IP / user / process / network) → Scope & Severity → Contain → Eradicate → Recover → Lessons Learned
Mappings: OWASP Top 10 · MITRE ATT&CK · Detection Engineering (KQL → Sentinel Analytics Rules)
Dashed = planned / later phase (Entra, Conditional Access)
Isolation: no public ingress anywhere; victims reachable only from snet-attacker via NSG; analyst reaches Kali via az container exec.
